audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Exodus / Shemot tabernacle instruction text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for bronze altar, courtyard, screen, oil for lamp, and continual light.

verses.restored: You shall make altar of acacia wood, five cubits length and five cubits width; altar shall be square, and three cubits its height.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.

verses.restored: Make its horns on its four corners; its horns shall be from it, and overlay it with bronze.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.

verses.restored: Make its pots to remove ashes, its shovels, basins, forks, and firepans; all its vessels you shall make bronze.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basons, and his fleshhooks, and his firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass.

verses.restored: Make for it a grating, network of bronze, and on net make four bronze rings on its four ends.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network of brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof.

verses.restored: Put it under ledge of altar from below, so net reaches halfway up altar.

familiar.text: And thou shalt put it under the compass of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.

verses.restored: Make poles for altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.

verses.restored: Its poles shall be brought into rings, and poles shall be on two sides of altar when carrying it.

familiar.text: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.

verses.restored: Hollow with boards you shall make it; as he showed you on mountain, so they shall make.

familiar.text: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount, so shall they make it.

verses.restored: You shall make court of dwelling-place: for south side, hangings for court of fine twisted linen, one hundred cubits length for one side.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:

verses.restored: Its twenty pillars and twenty bases shall be bronze; hooks of pillars and their bands silver.

familiar.text: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets shall be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

verses.restored: Likewise for north side in length, hangings one hundred cubits, its twenty pillars and twenty bases bronze; hooks of pillars and bands silver.

familiar.text: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings of an hundred cubits long, and his twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

verses.restored: Width of court on west side shall be hangings fifty cubits, their ten pillars and ten bases.

familiar.text: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

verses.restored: Width of court on east side, toward sunrise, fifty cubits.

familiar.text: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

verses.restored: Hangings for one shoulder shall be fifteen cubits, their three pillars and three bases.

familiar.text: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.

verses.restored: For second shoulder, hangings fifteen cubits, their three pillars and three bases.

familiar.text: And on the other side shall be hangings fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.

verses.restored: For gate of court, screen of twenty cubits, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twisted linen, work of embroiderer; their four pillars and four bases.

familiar.text: And for the gate of the court shall be an hanging of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework: and their pillars shall be four, and their sockets four.

verses.restored: All pillars of court around shall be banded with silver, their hooks silver, their bases bronze.

familiar.text: All the pillars round about the court shall be filleted with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass.

verses.restored: Length of court shall be one hundred cubits, width fifty by fifty, height five cubits, fine twisted linen, and their bases bronze.

familiar.text: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.

verses.restored: All vessels of dwelling-place for all its service, all its pegs, and all pegs of court shall be bronze.

familiar.text: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.

verses.restored: And you shall command children of Israel, and they shall bring to you pure beaten olive oil for light, to make lamp go up continually.

familiar.text: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.

verses.restored: In tent of meeting, outside veil that is before testimony, Aaron and his sons shall arrange it from evening to morning before YHWH; an age-long statute throughout their generations from children of Israel.

familiar.text: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the vail, which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the LORD: it shall be a statute for ever unto their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.

translation_notes: Bronze altar and court continue portable sacred service architecture.
Repeated poles/portable design show wilderness mobility.
Lamp oil comes from Israel and is tended continually; communal provision sustains sacred light.
Even technical measurements carry ordered access and boundary rather than spectacle.
safety_note: Do not treat courtyard boundaries as elitist exclusion detached from holiness; the text is arranging safe, ordered approach to presence.
